title: The Cascade of Stress: A Network Approach to Explore Differential Dynamics in Populations Varying in Risk for Psychosis
sample_size: 654 participants (244 healthy controls, 165 first-degree relatives, 245 patients)
limitations: - Small sample size; - Lack of diversity in sample; - Medication status not available for all studies; - Group average estimates used, not personalized networks; - No confidence intervals provided due to computational demands of permutation testing.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. Code and data availability are not clearly stated in the main text, but supplementary materials may contain this information. The authors used permutation testing for statistical inference, which is computationally intensive and may not provide confidence intervals.
